decisions: Part 60-batch2: acts chosen for their weight in everyday practice (criminal procedure and evidence, employment and labour relations, corruption, police, children, succession, marriage and family, electronic transactions, insolvency, access to information, tax administration, defence, forestry, energy regulation) among the MalawiLII acts whose current expression, and every earlier expression MalawiLII lists, could be read with its text. Acts whose newest page lists an amendment MalawiLII has not yet applied were left out (for example the Penal Code, the Courts Act, the Taxation Act and the Value Added Tax Act), because their last version would not be today's law. The Parliamentary and Presidential Elections Act, the Local Government Elections Act and the Companies Act, 1984 were left out of this batch until their status after later legislation is checked.

Most acts here start at MalawiLII's consolidation as at 31 December 2014 or 31 December 2017 (revised editions of the Laws of Malawi), the oldest version MalawiLII publishes; where that is also its current expression, the act has one version and no history of change in this record.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and the Malawi-specific scripts, and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
decisions_after: Part 60-batch2: the last version of each act is the text MalawiLII publishes as current, whose page lists no later amendment and none waiting to be applied. An amendment MalawiLII has not recorded at all would not be in this record; the acts whose only version is the 2014 or 2017 consolidation are the most exposed to that.
